reconcile.note: Henry harmonizes the itineraries by keeping the family in Bethlehem up to two years after the birth, so Matthew's magi visit doesn't erase Luke's census trip from Nazareth.

discrepancy.note: Strauss noted Matthew assumes Bethlehem as the family's habitual home while Luke has particular circumstances bring them there.

quotes.text: The one Evangelist seems to assume that Bethlehem was the habitual residence of the parents; but according to the other they are led thither by very particular circumstances.
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined (1846), ch. IV, on Luke 2:4.

sides.verseText: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

sides.snippet: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem
sides.verseText: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;
